reasons.core: Course design, accessibility, and quality review match most must-haves; LMS administration is only partly covered.
reasons.shape: Hands-on design and training work, close to the profile's day-to-day work.
reasons.domain: Higher education, the profile's main industry.
reasons.scope: Team leadership of four designers fits a specialist role with training duties.
reasons.tools: Canvas and Kaltura are named in both; the posting's D2L is not in the profile.
reasons.quals: The MEd in Instructional Design and Technology meets the degree requirement.

strengths: Course review checklist that cut review rounds from 3 to 2 across 40 courses matches the posting's quality-review duties.
Accessibility remediation of 120 course pages fits the WCAG compliance requirement.
Canvas and Kaltura experience covers two of the three named platforms.
gaps: D2L Brightspace is required; the profile lists Canvas and Moodle only.
The posting asks for LMS administration; the profile shows course-level work, not system administration.
summary: A solid fit for the design and quality work; prepare to address D2L and LMS administration.
jd_text: Fictional posting. Harborview College seeks an Instructional Technology Specialist to support faculty with course design, accessibility, and the D2L Brightspace LMS.
